description: Agent IP Records: submit renewal and maintenance records with the registrations they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each registration or granted patent with its id, number, kind, title, the moments its renewal or maintenance window opens and closes, the grace-period deadline its record states, its status and why a cancelled or expired registration ended (non_renewal or other); each renewal or maintenance filing with its id, reference, the registration, its kind (renewal, maintenance or declaration) and the moment filed; each fee payment with its id, reference, the registration it is recorded against, the filing it pays, the moment paid, the amount and the currency; each portfolio listing with its id, the registration and the status it lists. The signed report gives the registrations and the filings, each live registration past its window against a filing recorded in that cycle, each renewal payment against the registration of the filing it pays, each registration ended for non-renewal against the status the portfolio lists, and each grace-period deadline against the filings that meet it, and counts them, and names divergent renewal and maintenance records: a registration past its renewal or maintenance window with no filing recorded, a renewal payment recorded against the wrong registration, a registration cancelled for non-renewal that the portfolio still lists as active, and a grace-period deadline the records state that no filing meets; then a payment naming a registration or filing the records do not hold and a filing with no fee payment recorded, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No registrations, a live registration with no window stated, or a registration with no filing and no reading moment leaves those points unverified. Registrations, filings, payments and portfolio listings match by letters and digits, a filing counts for a registration’s cycle when dated on or after the window opens, windows and grace periods compare by the day, a registration already cancelled or expired is not read for a missed window, and filed, pending, published, allowed and registered read as active. This reads whether each registration is kept alive on time and each fee sits on the right registration. Verdict ip_renewal_divergent, ip_renewal_partial, ip_renewal_unverified or ip_renewal_consistent. POST /api/ip-renewal-check. Reads the intellectual property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it files no application, pays no fee, contacts no patent or trademark office or attorney and gives no legal advice, which stay with the owner, its IP counsel and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent IP Records reads a business’s own intellectual property records: trademark and patent application records, registration records, prosecution and office-action records, renewal and maintenance records, assignment and chain-of-title records as recorded at the IP office, license records, use and specimen records and docket records, each against the application, registration and docket records, the filing receipts and exhibits on file, the responses and the portfolio, the registrations, the register’s chain of title, the register records, the use records or the matters and filings on record. The family’s ground is the office record behind the brand and the invention: what was applied for, what registered, who the register says owns it, and whether the deadlines and licenses hold up; the Agent Legal family reads the contracts parties sign, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the tax authority, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-ip-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-ip-records/.
